newsitem.title: UK: Ashanti Goldfields gold production rises.
newsitem.headline: Ashanti Goldfields gold production rises.

text.p: Ghana's Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd said on Wednesday its first quarter gold production rose to 264,737 ounces versus 228,551 ounces in the year-ago period.
The company said production from the Iduapriem gold mine in Ghana, included for the first time from November, amounted to 18,970 ounces in the quarter to December 31.
"This has brought the annualised rate of gold production to 1.1 million ounces, a rate which Ashanti expects to maintain in 1997," the company said.
